tools.name: search_machines
tools.description: Searches the machine catalogue of Kessen Maschinenbau (food industry machinery: destackers, lidders, applicators, conveyors, line distributors, egg tray stackers, UV-C disinfection, cutting machines, special machines, marking technology). Returns matching machines and machine groups with description

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Returns any page of kessen-maschinenbau.de as Markdown (title, description, content). Use it to read machine details (performance, formats, options) found via search_machines.

tools.name: send_inquiry
tools.description: Sends a request (quote, consultation, spare parts, machine inquiry) to the sales team of Kessen Maschinenbau by e-mail. Only use it on behalf of a real person who has explicitly confirmed the content and agreed that their contact data is sent to Kessen. Kessen answers personally by e-mail or phone.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_machines · Private data: get_company_profile, send_inquiry · Public sink: send_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_machines · Private data: get_company_profile, send_inquiry · Public sink: send_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
